tagline.zh: 一條導絲跨過髂動脈，一通電話跨過整個下午
tagline.en: A wire crosses the iliac; one phone call crosses the whole afternoon

desc.zh: 複合手術室的一天：穿鉛衣、推導絲、看內漏、接急診電話。腳的脈搏永遠要自己摸。
desc.en: A day in the hybrid theatre: lead apron on, wires in, endoleaks out, ER on the phone. You always feel the foot pulses yourself.

desc.zh: 踝肱指數、雙功能超音波、術後的都卜勒訊號。外科醫師聽你說「有訊號」才敢關傷口。
desc.en: ABI, duplex ultrasound, the Doppler signal after the operation. The surgeon only closes when you say 'signal present'.

about.zh: 口袋裡有一支碼錶，記透視時間。他說：「看不清楚就換角度，不是多打對比劑。」
about.en: Keeps a stopwatch in his pocket for fluoroscopy time. He says: 'If you can't see it, change the angle, don't add contrast.'

about.zh: 昨晚摸了十二隻腳的脈搏，每一隻都記得。
about.en: Felt twelve feet for pulses overnight and remembers every one.

about.zh: C 臂是他的方向盤。鉛衣沒穿好，他不開機。
about.en: The C-arm is his steering wheel. If a lead apron is not on properly, he does not switch on.

about.zh: 全身抗凝給了幾點幾分，她記得比牆上的鐘準。
about.en: Knows the exact minute the anticoagulant went in, more precisely than the wall clock.

role.zh: 病人・76 歲退休郵差

about.zh: 腹主動脈瘤篩檢時發現，一年來看著它長到該修的大小。每天走一萬步，問開完還能不能走。
about.en: His aneurysm was found at screening and watched for a year until it reached repair size. Walks ten thousand steps a day and wants to know if he still can.

about.zh: 請了一天假，手機裡存著爸爸這一年的瘤體大小紀錄。
about.en: Took a day off work; keeps a year of his father's aneurysm measurements on his phone.

about.zh: 門診的指揮中心。她打來，就是有人的腳需要被看。
about.en: The clinic's control tower. When she calls, somebody's foot needs looking at.

about.zh: 她的電話只有一種語氣：快。
about.en: Her phone calls have one tone: fast.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來核對病人、手術、裝置與影像。血管手術還要核對左右腳。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops to confirm patient, operation, device and images. In vascular surgery, also which leg.

plain.zh: 肚子裡的主動脈像氣球一樣脹大。越大越可能破，破了會大出血。
plain.en: The main artery in the abdomen swells like a balloon. The bigger it gets, the likelier it bursts, and a burst means massive bleeding.

plain.zh: 從鼠蹊部的動脈放進支架移植物，從裡面撐住動脈瘤，不用開腹。
plain.en: A stent graft is passed in through the groin arteries to line the aneurysm from the inside, with no open abdominal incision.

plain.zh: 金屬骨架包著布料的管子，壓縮在細長的輸送系統裡，到位後再張開。
plain.en: A fabric tube on a metal frame, compressed inside a long delivery system and expanded once in position.

plain.zh: 支架放好後血還是流進瘤腔。分幾型，有的要馬上處理，有的可以追蹤。
plain.en: Blood still getting into the aneurysm sac after the stent graft is in. Different types: some need fixing now, some are watched.

plain.zh: C 臂角度不對時，腎動脈開口看起來會比實際位置高或低。要轉角度把它消掉。
plain.en: When the C-arm angle is wrong, the renal artery openings appear higher or lower than they are. The angle is adjusted until the error disappears.

plain.zh: 先走在血管裡的細金屬線，導管與支架都順著它走。
plain.en: A thin metal wire that goes first through the vessel; catheters and stents follow along it.

plain.zh: 打進血管讓 X 光看得到血流的藥水。對腎臟有負擔，能少用就少用。
plain.en: A liquid injected into vessels so X-rays can show the blood flow. It stresses the kidneys, so as little as possible is used.

plain.zh: 腳踝血壓除以手臂血壓。數字低代表腿的動脈塞了；太高可能是血管鈣化壓不扁。
plain.en: Ankle blood pressure divided by arm blood pressure. Low means the leg arteries are narrowed; very high may mean calcified arteries that will not compress.

plain.zh: 同時看血管的樣子和血流的速度，找狹窄、血栓與吻合口的問題。
plain.en: Ultrasound that shows both the vessel's shape and the speed of blood flow, to find narrowing, clots and problems at a join.

plain.zh: 動脈瘤破裂時故意不把血壓拉到正常，病人清醒就好，免得把剛形成的血塊沖掉。
plain.en: With a ruptured aneurysm the pressure is deliberately kept low, just enough to stay conscious, so the fresh clot is not washed away.

plain.zh: 走一段路小腿就痠痛，停下來休息就好。腿的動脈供血不夠的典型症狀。
plain.en: Calf pain after walking a certain distance that eases with rest. The classic sign of narrowed leg arteries.

plain.zh: 支架兩端要貼住的健康血管段。太短、太彎、太鈣化，支架就封不住。
plain.en: The healthy vessel segment each end of the stent graft must seal against. Too short, too angled or too calcified, and it will not seal.

text.zh: 可以轉角度的 X 光機。角度對了，腎動脈開口沒有視差；角度錯了，支架會放錯位置。
text.en: A rotating X-ray machine. Right angle, no parallax at the renal arteries; wrong angle, the stent graft lands in the wrong place.

text.zh: 雙功能超音波與都卜勒。門診量踝肱指數、術後聽足部訊號，都靠它。
text.en: Duplex and Doppler. Measures ABI in clinic and listens for foot signals after surgery.

text.zh: 複合手術室的制服。甲狀腺護頸也要戴。劑量計別在領口外面。
text.en: The hybrid theatre's uniform, thyroid collar included. The dosimeter clips outside the collar.

text.zh: 軟導絲先探路，硬導絲撐住彎曲讓輸送系統通過。尺寸與長度桌上全排好。
text.en: A soft wire finds the way; a stiff wire straightens the bends so the delivery system can pass. Sizes and lengths all laid out on the table.

text.zh: 廠商留下的展示品，布料加金屬環。周伯伯摸了一下說：「跟我以前的郵袋一樣硬。」
text.en: A demonstration piece: fabric and metal rings. Mr Chou felt it and said: 'As stiff as my old mail bag.'

text.zh: 兩臂、兩踝、足背與脛後的血壓，和算出來的比值。數字之外，還要記波形。
text.en: Both arms, both ankles, dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pressures, and the ratios. Besides the numbers, the waveforms are recorded too.

text.zh: 第一型：兩端沒封住，要立刻處理。第二型：腰動脈倒灌，多數追蹤。第三型：支架接合處漏，要修。
text.en: Type I: the ends have not sealed, fix now. Type II: back-flow from small branches, usually watched. Type III: a leak between components, needs repair.

text.zh: 破裂的動脈瘤：病人清醒、能說話就夠。衝血壓等於衝掉血塊。先止血，再補血。
text.en: Ruptured aneurysm: awake and talking is enough. Pushing the pressure up pushes the clot off. Stop the bleeding first, then replace the blood.

note.en: Handover: an EVAR and a clinic foot

lines.zh: 早。3 床昨天的腿部繞道，足背脈搏整夜都摸得到。
lines.en: Morning. Bed 3, yesterday's leg bypass: foot pulse palpable all night.

lines.zh: 第一台周伯伯，EVAR。門診十點半有個跛行的，雅君會打來要人量踝肱指數。
lines.en: First case Mr Chou, EVAR. At half ten the clinic has a claudicant; Ya-chun will call for an ABI.

lines.zh: 周伯伯的腎功能？對比劑要省著用。
lines.en: Mr Chou's kidneys? We'll need to be sparing with contrast.

lines.zh: 邊緣。黃主治會拿碼錶記透視時間，你知道的。
lines.en: Borderline. Dr Huang will time the fluoroscopy with his stopwatch, as you know.

lines.zh: 白板：08:00 EVAR（周伯伯）。10:30 門診踝肱指數。3 床：脈搏。
lines.en: Whiteboard: 08:00 EVAR (Mr Chou). 10:30 clinic ABI. Bed 3: pulses.

guide.en: Review the aneurysm neck with Dr Huang

lines.zh: 早。周伯伯的瘤頸符合裝置的使用規範嗎？
lines.en: Morning. Does Mr Chou's neck anatomy meet the device's instructions for use?

lines.zh: 長度夠、角度可接受、鈣化不多。遠端著陸區在兩側髂總動脈。
lines.en: Length adequate, angle acceptable, little calcium. Distal landing zone in both common iliacs.

lines.zh: 左髂動脈呢？
lines.en: And the left iliac?

lines.zh: 彎、有一段狹窄。可能要從右邊跨過去先處理。
lines.en: Tortuous, with a narrowed segment. We may need to cross over from the right and deal with it first.

lines.zh: 很好，你已經在想第二步了。去穿鉛衣。
lines.en: Good, you're already thinking two steps ahead. Go and put on your lead.

note.zh: EVAR 完成，第二型內漏追蹤
note.en: EVAR done; a type II endoleak to follow

lines.zh: 醫師，我昨天走了一萬兩千步。開完明天還能走嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, I walked twelve thousand steps yesterday. Can I walk again tomorrow?

lines.zh: 明天先走到走廊底。姓名、生日、要做什麼手術，說一次。
lines.en: Tomorrow, to the end of the corridor. Name, birthday and the operation, once for me.

lines.zh: 周文雄。從鼠蹊部放支架進去撐住腹主動脈瘤。兒子說叫 EVAR。
lines.en: Chou Wen-hsiung. A stent through the groin to line the abdominal aortic aneurysm. My son says it's called EVAR.

lines.zh: 醫師，他一年來的大小我都記著。這次真的到了要修的時候？
lines.en: Doctor, I've kept every measurement this year. Is it really time to repair it?

lines.zh: 到了。而且你的紀錄幫了我們很多。
lines.en: It is. And your record has helped us a great deal.

guide.zh: 時間暫停：裝置與影像核對

lines.zh: 時間暫停。周文雄，EVAR，過敏無，抗生素依醫囑。裝置尺寸與影像核對。
lines.en: Time-out. Chou Wen-hsiung, EVAR, no allergies, antibiotics per protocol. Device sizes against the imaging.

lines.zh: 主體、對側肢、延伸段，三個盒子都在？備用的呢？
lines.en: Main body, contralateral limb, extension: all three boxes here? And the spares?

lines.zh: 都在。鉛衣穿好的人才可以留在房間。
lines.en: All here. Only people in lead stay in the room.

lines.zh: 腎功能邊緣，對比劑用量我會記，術前依醫囑水化已給。
lines.en: Kidneys borderline; I'll log the contrast volume. Pre-hydration per protocol is in.

guide.zh: 對比劑與腎臟：你的計畫

lines.zh: 腎功能邊緣的病人，今天的對比劑你打算怎麼辦？
lines.en: Borderline kidneys. What's your plan for today's contrast?

q.zh: 腎功能邊緣的 EVAR，對比劑怎麼處理？
q.en: An EVAR in a patient with borderline kidneys: how do you handle contrast?

options.zh: 依醫囑水化、少打、多用角度與影像融合
options.en: Hydrate per protocol, inject less, use angles and image fusion

why.zh: 對。看不清楚先換角度，不是多打一針。術後追腎功能。
why.en: Right. If you can't see, change the angle rather than add a shot. Check the kidneys afterwards.

options.zh: 多打幾次看得清楚最重要
options.en: Inject more; a clear picture matters most

why.zh: 清楚很重要，但每一針都算在腎臟頭上。今晚可能會接到檢驗科的電話。
why.en: Clarity matters, but every shot is charged to the kidneys. You may hear from the lab tonight.

options.zh: 腎臟是內科的事，先不管
options.en: Kidneys are medicine's problem; ignore for now

why.zh: 對比劑腎病是我們打進去的。預防從術前就開始。
why.en: Contrast nephropathy is something we inject. Prevention starts before the case.

lines.zh: 入路。經皮還是切開？
lines.en: Access. Percutaneous or cut-down?

lines.zh: 右側血管乾淨、不深，經皮加閉合裝置。左側鈣化多，切開比較穩。
lines.en: Right side is clean and shallow: percutaneous with a closure device. Left is calcified; a cut-down is safer.

lines.zh: 超音波導引下穿刺。穿在股總動脈，不是分叉下面。
lines.en: Puncture under ultrasound. The common femoral artery, not below the bifurcation.

lines.zh: 全身抗凝依醫囑給了，時間記下。
lines.en: Systemic anticoagulation per protocol given; time noted.

guide.en: Cross the wire over the iliac

lines.zh: 左髂那段狹窄，先從右邊跨過去，用導絲帶球囊預擴。慢慢來。
lines.en: That left iliac narrowing: cross over from the right first, guidewire then balloon to pre-dilate. Slowly.

lines.zh: 透視中。角度照你說的。
lines.en: Fluoro on. Angle as you asked.

lines.zh: 黃主治的碼錶在跑。導絲尖端在螢幕上像一根探路的鬍鬚。
lines.en: Dr Huang's stopwatch is running. On the screen the wire tip feels its way like a whisker.

lines.zh: 主體要放在腎動脈下面。現在這個角度，腎動脈開口有沒有視差？
lines.en: The main body lands below the renals. At this angle, is there parallax at the renal openings?

lines.zh: 有。要往頭側與側向轉，直到標記環變成一條線。
lines.en: There is. Rotate cranially and laterally until the marker ring becomes a single line.

lines.zh: 你說角度，我轉。
lines.en: You call the angle, I turn.

q.zh: 點一下 C 臂，把角度轉到沒有視差
q.en: Tap the C-arm to rotate it to the parallax-free angle

post.zh: 好。釋放主體，確認導絲在對側開口裡，再放對側肢。
post.en: Good. Deploy the main body, confirm the wire is inside the contralateral gate, then the limb.

post.zh: 支架移植物在螢幕上一節一節張開，像一把反過來的傘。
post.en: The stent graft opens on the screen segment by segment, like an umbrella turned inside out.

lines.zh: 球囊塑形完。完成攝影。看什麼？
lines.en: Ballooning done. Completion run. What are you looking for?

lines.zh: 兩端有沒有第一型內漏、接合處有沒有第三型，還有瘤腔有沒有慢慢顯影。
lines.en: Type I at either end, type III at the joins, and whether the sac fills in slowly.

lines.zh: 晚期影像上，瘤腔有一小片淡淡的對比劑，從一條腰動脈倒灌進來。
lines.en: On the late images a faint wisp of contrast appears in the sac, back-filling from a lumbar artery.

lines.zh: 第二型。追蹤，不是今天處理。兩端封得很好。
lines.en: Type II. Followed up, not fixed today. Both ends sealed nicely.

post.zh: 閉合入路。然後我要聽到有人說「兩腳都有訊號」。
post.en: Close the access. Then I want to hear someone say 'signal in both feet'.

lines.zh: 右足背、右脛後，雙相訊號。左足背、左脛後，訊號在，比術前好。
lines.en: Right dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial, biphasic. Left both present, better than pre-op.

lines.zh: 記下波形，不只記「有」。今晚病房要跟這個比。
lines.en: Record the waveform, not just 'present'. The ward compares against this tonight.

lines.zh: 兩腳都有訊號。可以關了。
lines.en: Signal in both feet. You can close.

lines.zh: 紀錄：裝置型號與序號、對比劑總量、透視時間、第二型內漏、追蹤計畫。
lines.en: Note: device model and serial numbers, total contrast volume, fluoroscopy time, the type II endoleak, follow-up plan.

lines.zh: 還有左髂預擴的事，和兩腳術後的都卜勒波形。
lines.en: Plus the left iliac pre-dilatation and both feet's post-op Doppler waveforms.

lines.zh: 碼錶上的數字也寫。我們對自己也要誠實。
lines.en: Write the stopwatch number too. We are honest with ourselves as well.

note.zh: 門診踝肱指數：鈣化血管的陷阱

sub.zh: 跛行的病人到了，要量踝肱指數
sub.en: The claudicant is here; ABI needed

lines.zh: 醫師，58 歲計程車司機，走兩百公尺小腿就痛，糖尿病。黃主治說請你們量踝肱指數。
lines.en: Doctor, a 58-year-old taxi driver, calf pain after two hundred metres, diabetic. Dr Huang asked for an ABI from your side.

lines.zh: 收到。典型跛行。先摸脈搏、看腳的皮膚，再量。
lines.en: Got it. Classic claudication. Pulses and foot skin first, then the measurement.

lines.zh: 他說他的腳「不是問題，是車子的油門太硬」。
lines.en: He says his leg 'isn't the problem, the accelerator pedal is too stiff'.

lines.zh: 量踝肱指數有順序。躺平休息，再量。
lines.en: There is an order to measuring ABI. Lie flat and rest first, then measure.

q.zh: 量測踝肱指數的正確步驟
q.en: The correct steps for measuring an ABI

steps.en: Lie flat and rest for a few minutes

steps.zh: 都卜勒找足背與脛後動脈
steps.en: Doppler the dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial

steps.zh: 最高踝壓除以最高臂壓
steps.en: Highest ankle over highest arm pressure

post.zh: 右邊低，符合跛行。左邊的數字高得不像話，血管壓不扁。
post.en: Right side low, fits the claudication. Left is absurdly high; the vessel won't compress.

guide.zh: 跟黃主治討論鈣化血管
guide.en: Discuss the calcified vessel with Dr Huang

lines.zh: 左邊踝肱指數過高，是鈣化血管的假象。要加量腳趾壓力或看波形。
lines.en: Left ABI is falsely high: calcified vessels. We need toe pressures or the waveforms.

lines.zh: 對。數字太漂亮的時候，要懷疑。他的治療第一步是什麼？
lines.en: Right. When a number is too pretty, be suspicious. First step in his treatment?

lines.zh: 最佳藥物治療、戒菸、監督式運動。走路本身就是治療。
lines.en: Best medical therapy, stop smoking, supervised exercise. Walking itself is the treatment.

guide.zh: 和黃主治看 3 床的雙功能超音波
guide.en: Review bed 3's duplex with Dr Huang

lines.zh: 3 床，腿部繞道術後第一天的雙功能超音波。你報。
lines.en: Bed 3, day one after the leg bypass, duplex ultrasound. You present.

lines.zh: 先看吻合口，再看整條移植血管，最後看遠端波形。
lines.en: Anastomoses first, then the whole graft, then the distal waveforms.

question.zh: 腿部繞道術後的雙功能超音波，要確認哪些事？
question.en: What does a post-bypass duplex of the leg need to confirm?

answer.zh: 兩個吻合口沒有狹窄、移植血管全程通暢沒有血栓、流速正常沒有局部加速、遠端動脈的波形至少雙相。
answer.en: No narrowing at either anastomosis, the graft patent throughout with no thrombus, normal velocities without focal acceleration, and at least biphasic waveforms distally.

post.zh: 通暢。3 床可以下床走。去吃飯，十五分鐘，然後去看周伯伯。
post.en: Patent. Bed 3 can walk. Eat, fifteen minutes, then see Mr Chou.

post.zh: 黃主治按停了碼錶。今天的透視時間比他預計的少。
post.en: Dr Huang stops his stopwatch. Today's fluoroscopy time was less than he expected.

note.en: Mr Chou walked to the end of the corridor

lines.zh: 醫師，鼠蹊部有點痠，腳是熱的。我可以走了嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, the groin aches a little, the feet are warm. Can I walk?

lines.zh: 先讓我摸腳。足背、脛後都有。傷口乾淨沒有腫。今天走到走廊底就好。
lines.en: Let me feel the feet first. Dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial both there. Wound dry, no swelling. Today, the end of the corridor is enough.

lines.zh: 那個內漏，要擔心嗎？
lines.en: That endoleak, should we worry?

lines.zh: 第二型，大多數自己會停。一個月後電腦斷層追蹤，之後定期追。這是 EVAR 的一部分。
lines.en: Type II; most stop on their own. CT in a month, then regular follow-up. It's part of having an EVAR.

lines.zh: 追蹤我最會。我以前每天都走同一條路線。
lines.en: Follow-up I'm good at. I walked the same route every day for thirty years.

note.zh: 破裂的腹主動脈瘤：允許性低血壓，直上開刀房
note.en: Ruptured AAA: permissive hypotension, straight to theatre

sub.zh: 70 歲男性，背痛、低血壓、肚子有搏動腫塊
sub.en: Man of 70: back pain, hypotensive, pulsatile abdominal mass

guide.en: Take the call and run to the ER

lines.zh: 血管外科嗎？70 歲男性，突然背痛昏倒，血壓低，肚子摸到搏動腫塊，有腹主動脈瘤病史。
lines.en: Vascular? Man of 70, sudden back pain and collapse, hypotensive, pulsatile mass, known abdominal aortic aneurysm.

lines.zh: 破裂，先當它是。允許性低血壓，啟動大量輸血，通知黃主治、麻醉和開刀房。我馬上到。
lines.en: Rupture until proven otherwise. Permissive hypotension, activate massive transfusion, call Dr Huang, anaesthesia and theatre. I'm on my way.

options.zh: 允許性低血壓、大量輸血、直上開刀房
options.en: Permissive hypotension, massive transfusion, straight to theatre

why.zh: 對。病人清醒就夠。血壓衝高會把血塊沖掉。止血才是復甦。
why.en: Right. Awake is enough. Pushing the pressure up washes the clot away. Haemostasis is the resuscitation.

options.zh: 大量輸液把血壓拉到正常再說
options.en: Large fluid boluses to normalise the pressure first

why.zh: 正常的血壓會讓破口流得更快。這是允許性低血壓存在的原因。
why.en: A normal pressure makes the tear bleed faster. That is why permissive hypotension exists.

options.zh: 先做完整檢查與心電圖再決定
options.en: Full work-up and ECG before deciding

why.zh: 三徵：背痛、低血壓、搏動腫塊。檢查在路上做，不是在急診床上等。
why.en: The triad is there: back pain, hypotension, pulsatile mass. Tests happen on the way, not while waiting in the ER bay.

guide.zh: 開刀房：和黃主治決定夾閉位置
guide.en: Theatre: decide the clamp site with Dr Huang

lines.zh: 解剖不適合 EVAR，開放修補。近端夾哪裡？
lines.en: Anatomy unsuitable for EVAR; open repair. Where do we clamp proximally?

lines.zh: 先腎動脈下，能夾就夾。夾不到就先上腎上暫時控制，再往下移。
lines.en: Infrarenal if we can. If not, temporary supracoeliac control, then move the clamp down.

lines.zh: 麻醉準備好再夾，夾鉗一上血壓會跳。時間，記。
lines.en: Clamp only when anaesthesia is ready; the pressure jumps when it goes on. Time it.

lines.zh: 夾鉗上。出血慢下來。整個房間同時吐了一口氣。
lines.en: Clamp on. The bleeding slows. The whole room exhales at once.

note.zh: 交給夜班；師傅的三件事
note.en: Handed to the night team; the mentor's three things

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 周伯伯 EVAR，第二型內漏追蹤，兩腳都有訊號。急診破裂那位開放修補，進 ICU。3 床下床了。
lines.en: Mr Chou: EVAR, type II endoleak to follow, signal in both feet. The ER rupture: open repair, now in ICU. Bed 3 is walking.

lines.zh: 門診那位司機？
lines.en: The taxi driver from clinic?

lines.zh: 跛行，右邊踝肱指數低，左邊鈣化假性偏高。藥物、戒菸、走路。
lines.en: Claudication; right ABI low, left falsely high from calcification. Medication, stop smoking, walk.

lines.zh: 收到。今晚周伯伯的腳，每次巡房都摸。
lines.en: Received. Mr Chou's feet get felt on every round tonight.

guide.en: Dr Huang brings up the contrast

lines.zh: 早上你說腎臟是內科的事。
lines.en: This morning you said kidneys were medicine's problem.

lines.zh: 我說錯了。對比劑是我們打的。
lines.en: I was wrong. We inject the contrast.

lines.zh: 對。今晚追他的肌酸酐，明早告訴我。
lines.en: Right. Chase his creatinine tonight and tell me in the morning.

lines.zh: 今天三件事。左髂那段彎，你早上就想到要跨過去。
lines.en: Three things today. The left iliac bend: you planned the crossover before we started.

lines.zh: 踝肱指數太漂亮的時候，你懷疑了。破裂的那位，你沒有把血壓衝高。
lines.en: When the ABI was too pretty, you were suspicious. The rupture: you did not push the pressure.

lines.zh: 碼錶今天停在哪裡？
lines.en: Where did the stopwatch stop today?

lines.zh: 比我預計的少。去吃飯。
lines.en: Less than I expected. Go and eat.

note.en: A foot at night; the signal is still there

sub.zh: 周伯伯肌酸酐較術前上升
sub.en: Mr Chou's creatinine is up from baseline

lines.zh: 醫師，檢驗科危急值通報轉過來：周伯伯的肌酸酐比術前高。
lines.en: Doctor, a critical-value call from the lab forwarded to you: Mr Chou's creatinine is higher than before surgery.

lines.zh: 早上對比劑打多了。依醫囑水化、停腎毒性藥、追尿量、明早重抽。我會跟黃主治報告。
lines.en: We used more contrast than we should have this morning. Hydration per protocol, stop nephrotoxic drugs, watch urine output, repeat in the morning. I'll tell Dr Huang.

sub.zh: 周伯伯說左腳麻麻的、比較冷
sub.en: Mr Chou says his left foot feels numb and colder

lines.zh: 醫師，病房轉過來：周伯伯說左腳麻、比右腳冷。夜班摸不太到足背脈搏。
lines.en: Doctor, forwarded from the ward: Mr Chou's left foot is numb and colder than the right. Night staff can't clearly feel the pulse.

lines.zh: 左邊就是預擴過的那條髂動脈。都卜勒聽了嗎？
lines.en: Left is the iliac we pre-dilated. Has anyone put the Doppler on it?

lines.zh: 還沒。
lines.en: Not yet.

q.zh: EVAR 當晚一腳變冷、脈搏摸不到，第一步？
q.en: The night after EVAR a foot is cold and pulseless. First step?

options.zh: 親自檢查、都卜勒比對術後波形、通知主治、備急影像
options.en: Examine, Doppler against the post-op waveform, call the attending, arrange urgent imaging

why.zh: 對。支架肢阻塞是急症。有術後波形可以比，是下午那份紀錄的價值。
why.en: Right. A limb occlusion is an emergency. Having the post-op waveform to compare is exactly why it was recorded.

options.zh: 抬高腳、蓋被子保暖，明早再看
options.en: Elevate, keep warm, review in the morning

why.zh: 缺血的腳不要抬高，也不等天亮。
why.en: An ischaemic foot is not elevated, and it does not wait for daylight.

why.zh: 止痛會蓋掉缺血最早的訊號：痛。
why.en: Analgesia hides the earliest sign of ischaemia: pain.

guide.en: Go and check Mr Chou's foot

lines.zh: 醫師，左腳怪怪的。我是不是不該走到走廊底？
lines.en: Doctor, the left foot feels odd. Shouldn't I have walked to the end of the corridor?

lines.zh: 走得對。都卜勒：足背有訊號，脛後有訊號，和下午一樣。腳涼是被子踢掉了。
lines.en: You walked just right. Doppler: dorsalis pedis present, posterior tibial present, same as this afternoon. The foot's cold because the blanket's on the floor.

lines.zh: ……我以前送信也常常踢掉被子。
lines.en: ...I kicked blankets off back when I delivered mail, too.

lines.zh: 明天走到電梯。今晚每次巡房還是會摸你的腳。
lines.en: Tomorrow, to the lift. We'll still feel your feet on every round tonight.

sub.en: 'The ICU patient's feet are warm. 07:30 tomorrow.'

lines.zh: 一條導絲、一個內漏、一個踝肱指數、一個破裂、一條被子。腳都是溫的。
lines.en: One wire, one endoleak, one ABI, one rupture, one blanket. All the feet are warm.

lines.zh: 值班結束。鉛衣掛回架上，劑量計留在領口。
lines.en: End of shift. The lead apron goes back on its rack; the dosimeter stays on the collar.

sub.zh: 看不清楚就換角度，不是多打對比劑
sub.en: If you can't see it, change the angle, not the contrast
